total_weight_is_zero.meaning: totalWeight equals zero because no gauges have received votes

emission_indexed.meaning: the minted emission tranche is accounted in the GaugeManager index rather than left on the contract balance

emission_orphaned_on_balance.meaning: the emission sits on the GaugeManager contract balance and that tranche is lost forever

assumptions: Minter mints and transfers the emission tranche into GaugeManager before any index accounting occurs.
The emission tranche is a single distribution event whose accounting outcome is observable as indexed or orphaned.

unresolved.description: Report does not give the index/weight formula or numeric values, so the indexed-vs-orphaned correspondence is represented as grounded Boolean observables rather than a numeric identity.

limitations: Formalizes only the emission_orphaned impact; other listed impacts are not covered by this plan.
The condition is the report's zero-totalWeight subcase; the general requirement for nonzero voting is not separately encoded.
